label: Lactate, Capnia, and Fat Oxidation as Therapeutic Axes for SARS-CoV-2 Spike Protein-Induced Sequelae.
summary: Metabolic alterations characterize a large subset of those with post-acute COVID-19 syndrome, and similar symptoms affect those with post-acute COVID-19 vaccination syndrome. These symptoms are characterized by the triumvirate of post-acute COVID-19 (vaccination) syndrome symptoms: post-exertional malaise, fatigue, and cognitive impairment, commonly referred to as brain fog.
